observations.detail: MINI_ENTITY_0_6_SANDBOX.md still named binary sha256 2aa8ebe9d20a683b62627cfe9e20f245390b1422afaa805b42b2dddbc976eed3 while PROGRAM_STATE and the current local-LLM receipt bind 27ad1fc3f134efacabe89102a86ac5876d62bb7c9d9b1e6d0ca95c36c60e7bd1.

BLOGPOST_ENTITY.clay calls pipeline_profile_read and inference_generate, but tools/clay_profile_pipeline_runtime.py currently admits profile_load and provider_chat_json instead and does not admit those two new effect names.
BLOGPOST_ENTITY.clay run currently has three parameters (entity_db, source_db, secret_file), while test_blogpost_entity.py still invokes run with four values including an external profile path.

The current main listing of the artefact/blogpost_entity/native directory exposes the sandbox reference document but not the referenced mini_entity.c source file. This does not negate historical sandbox evidence, but it prevents this organ from rebuilding the exact native candidate from current canonical repository bytes.

unusual_experiment.result: The structured Clay surface requires exactly two effect names not admitted by the current reference runtime (pipeline_profile_read, inference_generate), and the current reference test supplies four arguments to a three-argument run entrypoint.
